user.title: Add an OpenNeato robot
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of a Neato robot running OpenNeato firmware.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Give the robot a fixed IP in your router.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the robot. Check the address and that the robot is awake and on Wi-Fi.
error.not_openneato: A device answered, but it is not running OpenNeato.

abort.wrong_robot: That address belongs to a different robot.
